title: IBRANCE (palbociclib): Dose-Modification Decision Points
instruction: For each clinical finding, decide whether the current IBRANCE Prescribing Information calls for holding or reducing the dose, or for continuing at the current dose unchanged.

items.prompt: Grade 3 neutropenia, or recurrent Grade 3 neutropenia, on Day 1 of a treatment cycle
items.rationale: Label instructs withholding IBRANCE until recovery to Grade ≤2, then resuming at the next lower dose; this is not managed with monitoring alone.

items.prompt: No more than Grade 1 or 2 neutropenia observed during the first 6 treatment cycles
items.rationale: Label states no dose adjustment is required in this scenario; CBC monitoring frequency may instead decrease to every 3 months before subsequent cycles.

items.prompt: Patient with severe hepatic impairment, Child-Pugh class C, starting IBRANCE
items.rationale: Label specifies a reduced starting dose of 75 mg once daily on the same 21-days-on/7-days-off schedule for Child-Pugh class C.

items.prompt: Patient with mild hepatic impairment, Child-Pugh class A
items.rationale: Label states no dose adjustment is required for mild or moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh A or B), unlike the reduction required for class C.

items.prompt: Severe renal impairment with creatinine clearance of 20 mL/min, not on dialysis
items.rationale: Label states no dose adjustment is required for any degree of renal impairment with CrCl greater than 15 mL/min.

items.prompt: Strong CYP3A inhibitor is medically necessary and cannot be avoided or substituted
items.rationale: Label first advises avoiding strong CYP3A inhibitors, but if coadministration cannot be avoided, it directs reducing the IBRANCE dose rather than continuing unchanged.

items.prompt: New or worsening respiratory symptoms (hypoxia, cough, dyspnea) suspicious for pneumonitis
items.rationale: Label instructs interrupting IBRANCE immediately and evaluating the patient when pneumonitis is suspected, prior to any decision on permanent discontinuation.

items.prompt: Patient vomits shortly after taking today's IBRANCE dose
items.rationale: Label instructs not taking an additional dose that day; the next dose is taken at the usual scheduled time, so the regimen itself is unchanged.
